description.fun: Noibat's giant ears are loudspeakers: it can give off sound at any wavelength, including ultrasound up to 200,000 hertz, using it to stun big creatures, chat with other Noibat and fly through pitch-black caves. It sleeps by day and comes out at night to hunt for fruit, using sonar to check whether it's ripe, which is why it keeps mistaking Applin for a snack.
description.guide: Noibat is a Flying- and Dragon-type bat Pokémon from Kalos. It lives in dark caves and uses ultrasonic waves from its large, speaker-like ears to navigate, communicate and stun prey. It is fond of fruit and evolves into Noivern.
description.tagline: A fruit-loving bat with loudspeakers for ears

description.fun: Noivern blasts ultrasonic waves strong enough to shatter boulders, and in the dark it's said to be unbeatable, cruelly toying with foes that can't see well, such as Hydreigon. It has a violent temper, but a gift of ripe fruit makes it tame, and bright light makes it timid. A bat-winged wyvern with speaker ears, it may also nod to Dracula, whose name comes from the Latin for dragon.
description.guide: Noivern is a Flying- and Dragon-type Pokémon that evolves from Noibat, combining a bat with a wyvern. It fires ultrasonic waves powerful enough to break rocks and is said to be unbeatable in darkness. It is short-tempered, but can be calmed with ripe fruit.
description.tagline: A bat-winged wyvern that rules the dark with sound
